name: ai-slop-cleaner
description: Remove unnecessary code and duplication while preserving verified behavior.

name: analyze
description: Trace repository behavior and rank evidence-backed explanations without editing code.

name: autopilot
description: Deliver an authorized task through requirements, reviewed planning, implementation, and verification.

name: best-practice-research
description: Answer version-aware technical questions using bounded official and upstream evidence.

name: cancel
description: Stop the current task safely while preserving resumable work and unrelated sessions.

name: code-review
description: Review a requested diff for concrete correctness, security, compatibility, and test gaps.

name: deep-interview
description: Turn a materially ambiguous idea into a bounded, testable specification through focused questions.

name: design
description: Create or refresh a repository design contract from product, UI, and accessibility evidence.

name: doctor
description: Diagnose this Gemini pack, CLI availability, configuration, and skill/plugin discovery.

name: performance-goal
description: Optimize a measured performance target through reproducible benchmarks and regression gates.

name: plan
description: Create or review a concise implementation plan grounded in repository evidence.

name: ralplan
description: Review a concrete plan through planning, architecture, and critical validation passes.

name: skill-creator
description: Create or adapt a Gemini skill with precise discovery metadata, practical steps, and real tool boundaries.

name: skill-manager
description: Inspect, validate, and manage skill sources without blindly executing downloaded content.

name: team
description: Coordinate bounded implementation lanes when real Gemini delegation is available, with an honest solo fallback.

name: ultragoal
description: Execute a durable multi-step plan with explicit criteria, checkpoints, and resume evidence.

name: ultraqa
description: Exercise runnable behavior with adversarial scenarios, bounded fixes, and cleanup evidence.

name: wiki
description: Maintain a small searchable Markdown project knowledge base with evidence and provenance.
